client_60fps_10_players.tail_honesty: 3.97 % of frames exceed 16.8 ms - this is 60 Hz vsync quantization (frame time lands on 16.7/16.8 ms either side of 16.667), not hitches: p99 = 16.8 ms. True hitches: 0.07 % of frames > 33 ms (max 33.4 ms, a 2-frame blip).

face_seam_adjudication.adjudication: (b) RENDERING DEFECT - geometry gap at the merged-terrain face boundary. NOT an expected over-the-planet's-edge view.
evidence: Close-ups (test/out/t7-final-05-seam-bottomleft.png, t7-final-06-seam-bottomright.png): large dark starfield regions in the NEAR ground (few m ahead of the avatar, bottom of frame) bounded by a perfectly straight razor-sharp diagonal edge against opaque terrain. Stars are visible THROUGH the gap -> the shell is transparent there (a real hole), not a shading/lighting seam (which would show dark terrain, not sky).

The horizon (view over the planet's rim, mid-frame) is clean and continuous - so the expected (a) rim view is present and correct; the defect is specifically the near-field wedge at the face boundary.
Static with a static camera (identical wedge shape in the 10 s-apart move pair and in the before/drop/after shots) -> static geometry gap, not a temporal/interpolation artifact.
C10's live lap already confirmed the sim/server side is seam-clean (physics crosses face boundaries without issues) -> the gap is client-side merged geometry only.

Reproducible in every full-frame screenshot on the fixed bundle (t7-final-01, -02, -03, -07, -13, -14): dark wedges in bottom-left and bottom-right corners, straight diagonal boundary, starfield through the gap.
face_seam_adjudication.mechanism_hypothesis: The two adjacent face grids do not meet exactly at the shared edge (edge vertices duplicated / not welded, or one face's grid stops fractionally inside the boundary). The slot is cm-scale in world space but projects to a large dark wedge at the grazing angle of the bottom of the frame; through it the skybox shows (single-surface shell).
face_seam_adjudication.report: FrontendFps observation: 'stars through the ground at face seams (dark wedge-shaped regions along cube-face boundaries at grazing angles)'
face_seam_adjudication.severity: Visual only (no gameplay/physics impact per C10). Most visible at 1:1 pixelRatio + AA off (crisp edges); likely less obvious at the old dpr 1.25/AA settings.
face_seam_adjudication.suggested_fix_direction: Report only (QA does not fix product code): weld/merge edge vertices so both faces reach the shared boundary exactly, or overlap the face grids by a small epsilon across the boundary so no slot can open.

sustained_20hz.comment: 10/10 clients green on all three gates. B's one-way p95 (17.5 ms) > A's (6.7 ms) is the per-process epoch-pin phase offset (t_up 0.90 vs 1.10 ms, different jump fit), not a delivery difference; both far under the 50 ms gate. loopLag p95 <= 9.8 ms (harness side, adjudicates decode stall vs delivery tail).
sustained_20hz.method: t7-sustain.mjs 60 s gate, split as two 5-client processes exactly as the 20:36 run: A --offset 0 --tag A and B --offset 5 --tag B, launched together, against :18080. Epoch pin re-run inside each process (input-phase sweep, t_up = RTT_p50/2, +/-~2 ms residual documented).
